source: HackerOne Hacktivity + Google-indexed disclosures + write-up cross-reference
disclosed_date_precision_note: approximate ±6 months (derived from H1 report-ID ranges)

disclosures.title: Attacker can view any user email via SaveCollaboratorsMutation
disclosures.vector_summary: Created dummy report, invited target via collaborator mutation; response field echoed the invitee's private email.

disclosures.title: IDOR: Authorization Bypass in LockReport mutation
disclosures.vector_summary: GraphQL LockReport mutation accepted any public report_id and locked it without authorization check.

disclosures.title: Hacker email disclosed on attachment in report
disclosures.vector_summary: A PoC video (h1_TabNab.mp4) attached to another report contained the hacker's email in-frame, exposed to viewers of that disclosure.

disclosures.title: SSRF via Analytics Reports (PDF generator)
disclosures.vector_summary: Injected <iframe> into report template element; backend Ruby PDF renderer fetched the URL server-side, exfiltrating AWS IMDS creds.

disclosures.title: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Analytics Reports
disclosures.vector_summary: Companion/variant of #2262382: PDF render path lacked output sanitization on error path, attacker forced outbound HTTP from renderer to internal metadata.

disclosures.title: View any user email using the API
disclosures.vector_summary: Auth'd user with API token enumerated user_id values; response leaked any user's primary email.

disclosures.title: Access Control Vulnerability: close report as duplicate cross-program
disclosures.vector_summary: Unauthorized user could close a report as duplicate of a report belonging to a different program / organization.

disclosures.title: /reports/:id.json endpoint discloses reporter PII
disclosures.vector_summary: Public .json representation of any disclosed report serialized reporter's email, phone, OTP backup codes, graphql_secret_token, tshirt size.

summary.auth_picture: Nearly all post-auth on hackerone.com GraphQL + REST. Only the .json endpoint disclosure (#3000510) is unauth-reachable against a known disclosed report URL.
summary.detection_difficulty_note: Splits two ways: GraphQL/IDOR class needs schema introspection and field-name awareness; PDF-render SSRF needs payload crafting inside a templated element. Neither is reachable by surface-scanning tools without flow context.
summary.bounty_picture: Healthy bounty range — $400 to $25,000. Three critical/high reports at $25k each; mid-severity often unbountied or undisclosed amounts.
